ports.name: Lost Odyssey (LostOdysseyRecomp)
ports.instructions:
Required files: Lost Odyssey Disc 1 (Xbox 360) -- USA/Europe edition (Redump 11817) or Europe/Asia edition (Redump 39111), as an ISO, GOD container, or extracted folder with default.xex. Disc 1 is required to start; discs 2-4 and DLC can be imported later from the same edition (never mix editions).

When asked which file to download, pick the .zip WITHOUT "-legacy" in its name.

Run the game once: the importer opens automatically. Choose Files or Folder, point it at your disc, confirm, then pick language and graphics settings. Additional discs and DLC: run InstallGame.exe in the port folder. First launch compiles shaders and can take several minutes.

Languages: English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Italian (USA/Europe edition) or English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Europe/Asia edition).

Requires Windows x64, an AVX-capable CPU and Direct3D 12 or Vulkan. Early testing: rendering and stability issues remain.
